microscopic_contract.behavior_summary: Invokes createMavenProject targeting editor tab. Reads action.data: artifactId, groupId, languageLevel, name, sdk. Touches state: files, project, tree.
microscopic_contract.project_effect_note: Documentation classification only. projectImpact=build|temporary|inspect is proposed but NOT runtime-enforced yet.

replay_contract.current_runtime: Player stepsThrough() replays every earlier IntelliJ action through SIM_SEEK after IntelliJ reset().
replay_contract.historical_action_behavior: Earlier actions run with replayingHistory=true; only the final action is current/animated.
replay_contract.focus_safety: Historical fidelity inputs suppress autofocus. typeCode uses focusRange and shared SIM_FOCUS.follow.
replay_contract.semantic_anchor_support: not_implemented; typeCode supports textual marker + position + derived focus lines

lesson_authoring_contract.temporary_demo_warning: Temporary project mutations must currently be explicitly undone; automatic projectImpact=temporary behavior does not exist yet.

limitations_and_non_assumptions: Catalog presence does not imply pixel-perfect parity with JetBrains IntelliJ IDEA.
Do not invent action.data keys not supported by the handler.
Do not assume projectImpact/checkpoints/semantic anchors exist yet.
Do not create a competing explanation box.
Do not use whole-screen blue overlays; control guidance is a persistent boundary, code/SQL uses shared line emphasis, and IntelliJ terminal current commands use yellow command emphasis.

transcript_matching.decision_rule: Match the transcript's visible IntelliJ interaction/result. If canonical_actions is empty, inspect candidates and engine source before deciding support.
